title: The Jazz Giants in Canada
summary: With Herbie Hall, Benny Morton, Claude Hopkins, Arvell Shaw and Buzzy Drootin the band plays eight-week Canadian runs four times in a year and cuts a record.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now, you had the Jazz Giants during this period---
Yes, I did that in Canada - we worked eight weeks at a time; once we did that four times in one year.
Now, that band was you and then Herbie Hall, on clarinet and, uh Benny Morton - was it - on trombone?
And, Arvell Shaw on bass and Buzzy Drootin and on drums Claude Hopkins was on piano.
That was a very good band - wasn't it?

Yeah - we made a record but none of us got rich - none of us got rich really. And, it was a band that should have never--- we should have gone on; the band was a sensational band and we went up there four times in one year and packed the place out.
And, you played in a few other places around---
Yes - we played (inaudible) -- we went to Chicago - I went to Chicago with the band and it was a big hit there.
I think that band stayed together off and on for about 18 months or so.
